name: Gaussian Splatting Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Gaussian Splatting Rasterization and Rendering Pipeline
definition: Orchestrates camera setup, SH evaluation, feature assembly, and Gaussian rasterization for a single view.
summary: The Gaussian Splatting Rendering Pipeline converts 3D Gaussian primitives into 2D images by orchestrating projection, SH evaluation, and front-to-back compositing, distinguishing itself through complete high-level orchestration rather than just low-level kernel logic.
